notes.text: Redesign Bakasura only: he must read as a hulking demon, not a plump man. Use charcoal-indigo skin (#2b2038), bare chest with a blood-red sash/drape (#8a1f1f), dark dhoti (#241a16), bone-coloured necklace and earrings (#d9c7a0), wild long red beard and moustache (#a8322a), belly 1.2, scale 1.12. Keep Bhima, Kunti, Brahmin and Ekachakra unchanged.

Keep the Bakasura redesign but make his face readable: skin #523f6b, beardLong false, short red beard and moustache (#a8322a), same bare chest, blood-red sash, dark dhoti, bone necklace/earrings, belly 1.2, scale 1.12. Keep Bhima, Kunti, Brahmin and Ekachakra unchanged.
